title: [DECISION] Lock ordering discipline in ikm_fd extraction prevents deadlock
description: src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c lines 1771-1826: ioctl_do_kdf acquires ks->lock (key source fd state lock) BEFORE state->lock (calling fd state lock). Lock ordering is explicitly documented and enforced consistently with ioctl_init pattern (lines 682-712). This prevents ABBA deadlock when concurrent threads call INIT on one fd while DO_KDF on another. The pattern ensures ks->lock is acquired and released entirely outside state->lock's critical section. This is non-obvious — naive implementations would acquire state->lock first, then try ks->lock, causing potential deadlock with concurrent INIT(key_fd=...) on a different thread. The explicit comment at line 1771 ('Lock ordering: ks->lock acquired and released BEFORE state->lock') makes the discipline visible.
